subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: The requested work remains valid, but two open PRs implement overlapping generator/check paths and both are currently conflicting, so automation should not choose or create a third implementation path.

options.title: Refresh the stronger proven sibling
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Repair the same-author closing PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 to address its proof/formatter concerns, resolve conflicts, and land that branch instead.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Close or pause both competing branches and ask for one fresh focused generator/check PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent credential matrix docs stabilization history and is the best available owner for choosing the implementation path.
